Community read-only MySQL MCP server (dpflucas/mysql-mcp-server), not an Oracle/MySQL official MCP. Requires project MCP configuration with MYSQL_HOST, MYSQL_PORT, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD, and optional MYSQL_DATABASE. Use a least-privilege read-only MySQL account. Prefer mysql-cli for authoritative MySQL operations.

Authoritative MySQL CLI option based on Oracle/MySQL official clients: mysql command-line client and mysqlsh MySQL Shell. No automatic install command is registered because installation differs by OS/package manager. Agents should detect mysql/mysqlsh first, then ask before installing system packages.

Authoritative PostgreSQL CLI option based on the official psql interactive terminal. No automatic install command is registered because installation differs by OS/package manager. Agents should detect psql first, then ask before installing system packages.

Official Neon Postgres Agent integration. neonctl init configures Neon MCP and installs project-level Agent Skills where supported. Neon also provides Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex plugin paths. Requires Neon OAuth/API auth and should be scoped to development projects or branches.

Local-first Postman integration route for agent-managed API collections, environments, tests, and integration runs. Prefer repository-local .ai/postman/scenarios.yaml as the LLM-facing workflow graph, compiled into .ai/postman/collection.json and .ai/postman/environment.local.json for Postman desktop import, local Postman CLI execution, or Newman v2.1 JSON runs. Use Postman MCP Server or Postman API only when cloud workspace CRUD/sync is explicitly required; POSTMAN_API_KEY is not required for the local-first path.

Three community skills for using [routerbase](https://routerbase.com/) as an OpenAI-compatible AI gateway: API integration, model routing, and media generation. The upstream repository contains only skill instructions and placeholders; users must supply their own RouterBase API key locally.
